criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs while applying direct capability coverage
keep missing capability matches visible as unsupported rather than inventing support

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream needs window and maps capabilities by exact need text. The observed coverage output matches the six supplied capabilities as direct and leaves n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported, so no downstream fault is localized here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve upstream provenance rank as ordering within each group
support recommendation with observed pain/outcome rather than generic keyword match

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered needs before genuinely unsupported needs and drives the final recommendation to prioritize a need already covered by cap-handoff. This is the top behaviorally significant root cause.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-row priority window and constructs the recommendation from the first priority record. Its output is wrong only because the incoming priorities are already mis-ranked by bnd-ec8195a15cc684b4.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: select demanded corpus rows while preserving fallback path
construct reviewable record dictionaries with required demand fields

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records keeps all eight supplied corpus rows because every demand_score is at least 3, with the explicit fallback path present. There is no evidence of unrelated candidate injection or generic keyword-only selection inside this package.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize selected evidence to bounded allowed-record window

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence preserves the allowed n06-r01 through n06-r08 window, normalizes numeric fields, and returns the bounded eight-row needs table consumed by the downstream handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: build ranked evidence-source provenance from normalized needs

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance ranks the normalized needs by demand_score descending with record_id tie-breaks, producing the evidence_sources table whose exact hash is handed to the downstream job.
